items.name: lemo-opuscar
items.description: Claude Code skill for short films with no video model: 51 film styles, each a style prompt plus a demo film made entirely in code by Claude Opus 5.5 (incl. OPUSCAR 98 and the new Evidence Films). By Lemomo. · Opus5.5 x 51 种影片风格：风格提示词 + 纯代码样片 + 导演与技术指南（新增「实证影像」）

items.name: explainroo
items.description: Explainer videos and product demos made by your AI agent. Free and open source: a local voice (Kokoro), word timing (Whisper) and a canvas renderer turn a script into a narrated MP4.

items.name: ai-promo-video-maker
items.description: 一句话让 AI 帮你做产品宣传片！把产品名或网址告诉 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程工具，它会自己调研产品、画出多种风格样图让你挑选、截取 4K 真实页面、按音乐节拍卡点剪辑、生成 AI 旁白并逐句转写校验、自动审图，最后交付一支 4K 商业宣传视频和可在线播放的网页版。App、网站、SaaS、开源项目、课程、AI 模型都能做，你只需确认需求、试听配乐。不用学剪辑软件，也不用花钱找外包。基于 Remotion + ElevenLabs，可直接克隆使用，也能一键安装为 Agent Skill。

items.name: claudemy
items.description: Claudemy: an open-source alternative to Udemy and Coursera. Give Claude a topic, it researches the web and builds a course of 2-minute audio lessons with cited sources. A free Claude Code skill.

items.name: showtime
items.description: A local video studio for your coding agent. Describe a video in one sentence: your agent directs, your machine renders. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Devin and more. No API keys, no uploads.

items.name: speech.cpp
items.description: Speech synthesis, speech recognition and voice activity detection for voice conversation, in C++ on ggml: Qwen3-TTS, Irodori-TTS, Qwen3-ASR, ReazonSpeech, parakeet and Silero VAD on Metal, Vulkan and the CPU, with an OpenAI-compatible server and live transcription.

items.name: NPCTalk
items.description: Make any NPC in any game talk back with Fish Audio: skills, a self-hosted voice server and tools for AI coding agents, with a full GTA V example.

items.name: html-explainer
items.description: 把一个主题做成有配音、字幕、封面的讲解分析类视频 —— 全本地、用 HTML 写画面，稳定音画同步。 面向 AI 编程智能体的确定性 HTML → MP4 渲染流水线。

items.name: eidolon-sc
items.description: 和《偶像大师 闪耀色彩》偶像实时语音/文字对话的 AI 分身：日语原声 + 中文字幕、回忆原作剧情、跨角色共享记忆；支持 Google/GitHub 登录与自带密钥，Docker Compose 一键部署（参考 LAPLACE Eidolon）

items.name: Lampline
items.description: Self-hosted voice agent platform: import your Dialogflow CX and CX Agent Studio agents, build and test them, and take calls on your own hardware. 20 model providers, phone and SIP through jambonz.
